body:
Can confirm this still occurs in v4.4.1.stable.mono

Some more testing leads me to believe that the issue has to do with locking the main thread while a separate thread attempts to load something with a C# script dependency. I can only speculate that whatever code is responsible for "fetching" a CSharpScript resource (i.e. instantiating a subclass of `GodotObject` or loading a scene with script nodes) requires running code on the main thread.
Attempting to load a script in a sub thread, and locking the main thread until the loading is finished (which `LoadThreadedGet` does) always causes a deadlock.
Whereas attempting to load the script in the main thread directly (via GD.Load or ResourceLoader.Load), it never causes a deadlock as it already is running on the thread it wants to.

Another note: I tried recursively loading all `.cs` resource dependencies in the main thread and caching them before queuing the scene to load on a sub thread, and that still didn't prevent the deadlock. So the main thread requirement might be in the "fetching of the script resource", not so much the "loading from the filesystem".

I can confirm that this issue does not reproduce in v4.5.beta4.mono.

Appears to have been fixed by #99798
